Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
